One of the more enjoyable ToTs, but one of the most awkwardly staged as well. Cobb blows his lines in the early segment, the lighting in this segment is odd, as well. One camera was dark,the other brightly lit, and when they switched camerasm I thought for a moment they had switched to another film! There's even a segment where, if you watch closely, you can see off the set for a half-second (through the office window). Oh, well, that's live TV! Overall, one of the better scripts, and Cobb's acting (when he remembers his lines) carries through.

I have come to the conclusion that I hate the organ music on the earliest episodes of this series. The shows were a great deal better when that was put aside.
